operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single **credit type** by id.

A credit type defines a kind of credit/points balance (e.g. loyalty points). The record id is supplied in the path; the response is the flat record (`id`, `name`, `allow_decimal`, `status`, `unit`, `description`, `created`, `modified`, `deleted_at`) — not wrapped in an envelope.

The trailing path segment (e.g. `/credit_type/{id}/1`) sets the data-detail level; it is optional for this entity and does not change the returned record.

If the id does not exist, the endpoint currently responds with HTTP `500` and a plain-text `error happened` body (not JSON). Confirm the id exists (e.g. via the list endpoint) before fetching.

allow_decimal.description:
Whether fractional amounts are allowed.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | No |
| 1 | Yes |

status.description:
Whether the credit type is active.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

unit.description: Unit label for the credit; null when not set.

description.description: Free-text description; null when not set.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when the record is active.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or expired. A caller who is authenticated but lacks view permission for this entity also receives a `401` with a message stating access is not allowed.

500.description: Currently returned when the id does not exist or cannot be loaded — a plain-text `error happened` body. Check the id exists (e.g. via the list endpoint) before fetching.
